description: Lieux de comptage de Place au vélo à Nantes is a dataset listed in Open Data Nantes Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Place au vélo. Lieux de comptage de Place au vélo à Nantes. Localisation des lieux de comptage de l'association Place au vélo lors de leurs campagnes annuelles de comptage. Coverage: Nantes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are Place au vélo, vélo, Comptage. The portal shows 5 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-10-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-nantesmetropole-fr-portal.
